title: A green project button on Home, with a list of the others; every page follows the chosen project
request: Beside New project from chat, on its left, a green button that shows the project we are in, with a drop-down of the other projects; all tabs and all details, and the sidebar, must be the selected project's.
spec: Home read the workspace's sum; the project pages read DC.state.project or the first project; there was no way to choose from Home.
plan: A reusable switcher in the core, mounted first in the header actions of Home and of every project page
Home's cards, needs, jobs and project list scoped to the selected project, with a way to show all
The choice kept across a reload; the sidebar's Project label and the project pages follow it

decisions.decision: The Projects tab shows the selected project and offers Show all N projects.
decisions.why: The owner asked for every tab to show only the selected project; the full list stays one click away and in the green button's list.

decisions.decision: The choice is kept in the browser (dclab-project) and restored when no project is chosen.
decisions.why: After a reload the person returns to the project they were on, not the first one.

decisions.decision: The Evidence tab and the evidence library stay the workspace's.
decisions.why: They are the shared library, not a project's data.

change: web/src/core.js (projectSwitch, currentProject.id restore, icons), look.css (the green button and its list, tokens only), views/home.html (scoped cards, needs, jobs, projects tab, a project change lets go of the last chat), scripts/browser_e2e.py (a switch check; the stats check follows the project).

findings.defect: There was no way to see or choose the project every page follows.
findings.scenario: On Home the person saw the workspace's numbers and a list; the sidebar named a project chosen by an earlier click or the first one.
findings.cause: The choice lived in DC.state.project, set only by links on other pages.
findings.fix: A green switcher in each header, kept across a reload.

findings.defect: The browser test compared Home's cards to the workspace's sums.
findings.scenario: With Home scoped to a project the stats check would have failed on a workspace with a project.
findings.fix: The check compares them to the selected project's own numbers.

measurements.name: The switcher on the owner's workspace
measurements.gate: the button, its list, the sidebar and Models follow the choice, at 1280 and 375 px
measurements.result: switch, stats, pages and mobile checks pass on a workspace of 3 projects

outcome: The person sees which project they are in, picks another from Home or a project page, and Home, the sidebar and the project pages follow it.
lessons: A choice that every page reads must have one visible control and one place that keeps it.
risks: The Intern, Compute and Lab pages are the workspace's and do not follow the choice.
